10108010.t: Hideout
A quiet, peaceful afternoon. The first in ages.
[The perfect choice for anyone who's been going nonstop.] Ad
[Refresh your weary body and mind with 100% natural herbal ingredients.] Ad
[Take a moment just for you. Chilling Tea Water.] Ad
"Going nonstop," huh...
*Sigh*... What a life...
How long has it been since I arrived in this strange world?
Everything I've been through so far feels completely surreal...
Not that I've hated every second of it…
Vanity of vanities! All is vanity!
*Sigh*... What's the point of any of it?
The thoughts drift past, just like the video playing in front of me...
Just as I suddenly ended up here from the world I once lived in...
I might wake up one day to find myself dropped into yet another world.
So much for the meaning of life. All is vanity.
Right. For now, I'll just soothe my weary body and mind...
...Is she gone?
Good grief. What a pushy salesperson. Just when it was getting good, too...
Gaaah!!!!
My minion! Are you alright?!
I have come to save you, so fear not!!!
...Huh? You're... that melodramatic pharmacist from Saverim?!
...Huh? You're completely fine...?
Ack! W-Wait, time out!!
Stop right there!! Don't come any closer. Turn around for a moment!
...Huh? Why are you squirming around like that?
Is there something under the desk?
Stooop!! I told you to stop!!!
C-Could it be you've already fallen under the Curse of Ruin?!
Worry not, my minion! I shall save you!
Wait till I put some pants on, you idiot!!
(A moment later)
...A-Ahem. So that's what was going on...
Then why didn't you just tell me to wait?
No matter how much I knocked, there was no answer, so I assumed you had collapsed!
Hey, that still doesn't justify smashing my window to get inside!
Besides, I clearly told you to stop! You're the one who kept coming closer!
N-Ngh...
T-Then you should have at least said you were inside!
And what on earth were you doing with your clothes off in the first place?!
T-That's...
Well... you know.
I was... thinking about... world peace!
World peace...?
C-Could it be?!
Yeah... Exactly what you're thinking.
Ngh...! I knew it...
Yes... That's right.
...Kukuku! Kukukuku!
I see! Your memories from a thousand years ago have finally returned!!
Yeah, you're righ— Huh? Memories from a thousand years ago?
Yes! A thousand years ago, when the <bouten>Primordial Apocalypse</bouten> began!
We sealed away the apocalypse together and saved the world!
...Oh. More of her made-up backstory.
Pretty sure I'd remember doing something like that...
A glorious day indeed! Kukuku! Is this fate's doing too...?
Hey, are you listening to me?
Ku, ku, ku. Then allow me to introduce myself once more...
Yes—I am the hero who sealed the Primordial Apocalypse, Rana Apocry—
Ack!
Ngh...! Why is the floor so slippery?!
My minion! You should really keep your floor clean!
Seriously though, what did you actually come here for?
Huh? Well, that's...
...Ah! That's right!!
My minion! I have a favor to ask!
Please save me!!
...What?

10108020.t: (A few days ago...)
Saverim
Mmm, hmm-hmm!♪
Hello! Good morning!
Kukuku... Kukuku!
Huh?
Oh, Rana! Ehehe, good morning!
You're finally out of your room! Did you finish what you were working on?!
Kukuku, yes. I've just finished it...
With this, the world is safe from calamity once more! Ku, ku, ku...
Calamari? What's that? Is it yummy?!
Kukuku...
That is forbidden knowledge granted only to those bound by a lonely fate…
Ordinary humans like you needn't concern yourselves with it. Ku, ku, ku...
Oh, got it! Doesn't sound very tasty anyway!
Kukuku...
Indeed... Such is the burden of one destined to walk alone—
Oh, by the way, Rana! You should still come out and say hi once in a while, even when you're making medicine!
We hadn't seen you in days! We thought something had happened to you. Sophia was really worried, too!
Kukuku. Rest assured!
My contract binds me to this place.
I shall remain here, so worry not. Kukuku...
Aww, there you go again with words only you understand!
Nobody knows what you're talking about!
Kukuku... It matters not.
Forbidden knowledge is poison to the unworthy. Kukuku.
Ehehe! So that's why you know so much about poison, Rana!
So what you've been working so hard on these past few days was—
What?! Don't be ridiculous! I made an elixir, not poison!
Stop calling my elixir poison, dummy!
What?! I'm not a dummy! Takes one to know one!
No, you're the dummy!
Oh? That voice...???
My, you two are getting along nicely this morning.
Oh, Sophia! Good morning! Ehehe!
Ah, Sophia! My special elixir is complete!
Kukuku! The curse is no more!
Oh my, so you stayed in your room all this time to make medicine!
You haven't been staying up all night again, have you?
Hmph... Not you too...
I am no longer the same person you rescued in that alleyway!
I can take care of myself perfectly well!
Yes, yes, I know you can take care of yourself, Rana. But still!
Don't spend all your time making medicine. Come out and eat with us sometimes.
Hmph... A-Alright...
Speaking of which, Rana, you ate the meals I left by your door, but...
Then why did you leave the bell peppers every time?
T-That was... I-It wasn't me!
Eileen must have left those bell peppers!
What?! It wasn't me! I hate bell peppers, but I still eat them!
You traitor! We agreed we weren't eating the bell peppers!
Hehehe, I see how it is.
I know making medicine is tiring, but please eat your bell peppers next time, too.
Hmph... F-Fine...
Now then, shall we open up the clinic for today?
Come to think of it, we've been getting more and more patients lately.
I'm a bit worried. I wonder if there's a bug going around...
Kukuku. Fear not, Sophia.
Hunting curses is as easy as eating pudding for one such as myself.
I shall make up for my absence by dealing with every last case! Ku, ku, ku...
Hehehe, is that so? Then I'm counting on you, Rana!
(The next day)
Whoa! There are so many people already!
Are you okay, Rana? Aren't you overdoing it on your very first day?
Kukuku... This familiar chill... It has been far too long.
Rest assured, Eileen. Who do you think I am?
I am the one destined to walk alone, Rana Apocrypha Lil—
Excuse me... Could I have some medicine, please...?Patient A
...Ahem. R-Right.
(Two days later)
Wh-Why are there so many people...?
Nnngh... C-Coming through...!
...Huh? Rana, you don't look so good. Are you okay?
You look like you ate something really gross... Did you have bell peppers for breakfast?
Kukuku... Bell peppers?
Eileen, you think bell peppers taste bad? I find them far more delicious than pudding.
Oh, come on! How could bell peppers taste better than pudding?!
It's true... You only say that because you've had such an easy life.
Kukuku... After all I've been through, even bell peppers taste as sweet as pudding...
S-Sophia, come quick! Something's wrong with Rana!
(A few days later)
Aaargh! I cannot take another second of this!
Why do patients keep flooding in?!
At this rate, we shall all perish!!!
Yay! Rana's back to normal!
Oh my! It looks like you've finally perked up, Rana!
Ngh...! A-Are you two really okay with this?!
If we keep working without a moment's rest, we'll be the ones collapsing first!!
Well, what are we supposed to do? The patients keep coming...
*Sigh*... From what I hear, the other clinics are in the same boat.
The number of patients keeps rising every day, so everyone's swamped...
...K-Kukuku. You finally understand how dire the situation is.
But fear not! I have a brilliant idea!
Wow, really?! I knew you could do it, Rana!
Kukuku, yes... Th-Then I must prepare at once.
I must prepare for the contract... Ahem. Not because I don't want to work, of course...
...Huh? Prepare for a contract?
Huh? Then what about the afternoon appointments—
There's something far more important to attend to!
So I really must be going now—!!
Oh my!
Ah, Rana! I told you not to jump out the window!!!
Whew, there's really no stopping her.
Sophia, should I go get Rana?
Mmm... No, she'll be alright.
I think I know where she went. Hehe.

10108030.t: Hideout
That is what transpired...
...Hmm, okay. I think I've got the picture.
Kukuku... That's my minion! You already understand my—
So basically, you ran away because you didn't feel like working, right?
Huh?
...W-What are you talking about?! As if I would run away!
But even you must think it's strange that we're getting this many patients!
...Hmm, I haven't lived here all that long myself, but...
People in this neighborhood beat each other up over the stupidest things every day.
So isn't having a ton of patients completely normal?
E-Even so, we don't normally get this many!
Besides, Humanitas has tens of thousands of clinics! Why are they all so crowded?!
Wait, there are that many clinics in this neighborhood?
I thought yours was the only one since I ended up there after getting hit by a car...
As you said, there are countless patients every day! Of course we need that many clinics!
But lately, there have been far, far too many!
Just today, there were THIS many! THIIIIS many!!
And I hear the other clinics are just as bad!
...Right, okay, I get that there are a lot of patients.
So why come to me? It's not like I know anything about medicine.
Ahem...
My minion, you work as a Fixer in this timeline, do you not?
Lend me your strength and wisdom!
Together, we shall discover why the Curse of Ruin has spread so far! Kukuku...!
Well, if you're hiring me, I guess I can take the job.
...But what's all this about an apocalypse and a curse?
Do you have any idea what's causing it?
...!  Ku, ku, ku! Ah, so that is what you wish to know...!
It seems your memories have not yet fully returned.
Very well! I shall explain it all to you, step by step—
Ah, no need for all that. Just keep it short.
B-But you won't understand if I leave things out...
Then make sure I do.
Besides, I think I already get the gist of it.
Nnngh... A-Alright...
Well... A thousand years ago, the Primordial Apocalypse began.
And you... Kukuku. You joined forces with me to seal it away.
Ah, right, you came up with that story earlier.
Hmph! I didn't make it up! It really happened!
Okay, but what does that have to do with all these patients?
...Ku, ku, ku. Allow me to continue...
A thousand years ago, we sealed away the apocalypse and saved the world, but...
One thing happened that neither you nor I could have foreseen.
Something unexpected...
Is that where this "curse" stuff comes in?
Kukuku... That's my minion.
Indeed. Once it was sealed, a new threat emerged: the Curse of Ruin...
It is not as powerful as the Primordial Apocalypse, but it slowly eats away at our minds and bodies...
People came to know the Curse of Ruin by another name: "disease"...
Right. And?
What does this "Curse of Ruin" have to do with there being so many patients?
K-Kukuku... W-Well, you see...
Th-This curse... seems to be... an exceptionally powerful one...
Then why are you and I both perfectly fine?
...K-Kukuku... Proof that we are the chosen ones...
If I, your master, am unharmed, then surely my minion is safe as well!
...Alright, moving on. There's another thing I don't get.
You said this curse showed up a thousand years ago. Why is it suddenly a problem now?
Uh, well... Y-You see...
The Curse of Ruin... no matter how many times you cleanse it, it keeps coming back...
...So what exactly do you expect me to do about that?
Like I said, I'm not exactly trained to treat people.
If it keeps coming back no matter how many times you get rid of it, it doesn't sound like there's much I can do to help.
A-Ahem... Well, about that...
...K-Kukuku. That's my minion. A-An excellent question...
But th-the time has not yet come...
First... Yes! Why don't we pick up where we left off?
...Where we left off?
Ku, ku, ku... You still haven't recovered all your memories, after all.
Allow me to tell you of your past. We can enjoy some pudding as we talk. Kukuku...
(Where did the pudding come from...?)
How long are you going to keep up this roleplaying routine...?
Huh...? Roleplaying? What do you mean?
...Never mind.
By the way, do you really have time to hang around like this? I thought you had a ton of patients.
...Come to think of it, should you even be here right now? Aren't you supposed to be super busy?
...K-Kukuku.
One must have priorities...
For I have a solemn duty to observe the tangled threads of fate—
Huh?
...I see. So that's how it is.
Kukuku, indeed! I am the hunter of the Curse of Ruin, Rana Apo—
Ah, yeah, whatever.
Sophia told me to bring you back. She said you've rested more than enough.
Whaaat?!

10108040.t: After Sophia called, I brought Rana back to Saverim...
Saverim
[In other news...]Announcer
[Recently, an increasing number of citizens in Humanitas have been suffering from lethargy.]Announcer
[While the exact cause remains unknown, experts say it is highly contagious—]Announcer
Uuugh... I'm dying... I'm gonna die...
I can't do this anymore... I can't even lift a finger...
Waaaah... This is so exhausting!
It's been nothing but work! I can't even remember my last walk...
Aaaaargh!!
Get off me! You're heavy!!
Uuugh... I can't move anymore...
Rana, give me a piggyback ride...
What are you talking about, you stupid dog?! How am I supposed to carry you?!
Nnngh! I-I can't even budge you! What do you eat to get so big and heavy?!
Ehehe... You're so squishy and cozy!
...*Sniff, sniff*. Hmm?
This sweet smell... Is that strawberry pudding...?
...Ahem.
R-Rana... Did you eat pudding without telling me...?
I-I didn't eat any!
It's written all over your face!
That's not fair! Why didn't you share?!
H-Hey! That was my portion, so of course I ate it!
What about you?! You ate that melon custard pudding all by yourself last time! I wanted to try it, too!
W-Well, you ate that chestnut tiramisu pudding last month—
...*Sigh*. Do those two ever get tired...?
Oh, there you all are!
You've all worked so hard today. I brought us something to eat, so let's take a break together.
Yaaay! You're the best, Sophia!
Hey! Wait! Don't pick before me!
Thank you so much for your help today, <:player>!
Things have been so chaotic lately... I'm so glad you were here to help, <:player>!
Whew, it's not like I came here planning to volunteer, but...
Anyway, how many patients did we see today? This place was packed.
Hmm, well... We had about 300 people today. Usually, it's just over 100 at most...
We started getting a lot more patients about a week ago, and it's only gotten worse...
[—Meanwhile, health authorities are facing heavy criticism for failing to respond quickly to this epidemic in its early stages.]Announcer
[Fortunately, several pharmaceutical companies are developing treatments. One to watch is Black Medicine Co.'s—]Announcer
Are all the extra patients coming in with that?
Lethargy Syndrome? The one where people lose almost all motivation?
Yes... It leaves people with only their most basic needs and urges. Even everyday life becomes a struggle.
In severe cases, patients may even stop eating or sleeping, so we have to be especially careful.
...Wait, you haven't been handling all of this with just the three of you this whole time, have you?
Your workload's tripled. Can't anyone send you some extra help?
Haha... Unfortunately, the other clinics are in the same boat...
For now, we have no choice but to manage with the staff we already have.
Exactly! The situation is dire!
At this rate, we'll collapse too... Then who will treat the patients?!
We can't just keep treating patients as they come in! We have to find the cause!
Whoa. Since when are you the voice of reason?
Hmph! Such disrespect, my minion! I've always been clever!
Sounds to me like you just don't want to work...
Still, you've got a point. After today, I get it.
If the number of patients doesn't go down and no help is coming, you'll reach your limit soon.
...Yes, but as things stand, we have no other choice.
We can't just turn patients away because we're exhausted.
But we have no way of finding out what's causing Lethargy Syndrome...
Well, figuring out the cause is why I came here.
Your pharmacist hired me to look into it.
Oooh! You're going to help us, <:player>?!
That was my original plan, but I'll need to change things up a bit.
I have to head over to Vermont soon anyway.
You're going to Vermont...?
N-No! Please don't abandon us, <:player>!!
Don't put it like that... You only asked me about this today.
I already had plans. I can't just cancel them. But don't worry, I'm not abandoning you.
Which means...
You'll all collapse before I get to the bottom of this.
So first, let's deal with the immediate problem of patients pouring in nonstop.
Ehehe! I knew we could count on you, <:player>!
Kukuku... That's my minion.
Now then, let us hear it. What is your plan?
Actually, you're the key to this plan.
I'm counting on you. I can trust you with this, right?
What...?!
...Kukuku! Mwahahaha! So you need my help... Ku, ku, ku!!
Very well! It has been some time since we last joined forces. Fate must have brought us together once more...
Speak, my minion! What would you have me do?!
I mean, what else would I ask a pharmacist to do?
Huh?
Make some medicine.

10108050.t: Saverim
<:player>, what exactly do you mean by "make medicine"...?
First, I need to check something...
Your medicine can cure Lethargy Syndrome, right? You're sure about that?
Kukuku. Naturally.
There is no disease that my medicine cannot cure!
Then the plan is simple.
Rana, make as much medicine as you can to buy us some time.
Huh?
Meanwhile, I'll make a quick trip to Vermont. Once I'm back, I'll get to the bottom of this.
How about that? Easy, right?
Mmm... Making a whole bunch of medicine...
Something occurred to me while I was working today.
Can't you just make a huge stash of medicine ahead of time?
Then whether 300 or 3,000 patients turn up, you just give them the medicine, right?
...Ahaha. Well, yes, in theory...
So I don't see why having so many patients is a problem.
It's not like making medicine takes an eternity or anything—
Hold on a secooooond!!!
...K-Kukuku.
My minion, I understand your confusion.
Allow me to explain.
Huh? Uh... Sure, go ahead?
First, let us clear up one misunderstanding.
The medicine I make is...  special.
Very, very, VERY special.
It's in a league of its own, far beyond anything those amateurs could make. Ku, ku, ku...
Um... I-Is that so?
Kukuku... I'm sure you're wondering what makes it so different.
I make each dose specifically for the person who will take it.
...Then doesn't it take way too long to make just one dose?
...Kukuku. It cannot be helped.
But that is what makes my medicine so effective!
Kukuku... Supreme alchemy, capable of bending fate itself—
Okay, can we focus on the problem here?
Huh?
With this many people needing medicine, you have to compromise.
You made medicine for all those cats when they went berserk, didn't you?
Th-That was different! I was trying to prove that medicine could surpass magic!
But this is nothing like that...! You're simply telling me to mass-produce it!!
Oho... I see, so that's how it is...
Just checking... You can make a general-purpose medicine, right?
O-Of course! There's no medicine I can't make!
Great. Then let's make a big batch in advance.
That way, even when patients flood in, all you have to do is hand out the meds. Much easier.
W-Wait, my minion!
Artificial scents and simple antidotes are one thing! But you can't give everyone the same medicine just because they have the same illness!
Everyone's body is different! Their habits are different! You can't just lump them all together and call that medicine!
Look, under the current circumstances—
Medicine isn't just about fixing the immediate problem!
Making medicine without considering who's taking it is reckless! One mistake could ruin someone's life forever!
I'd rather collapse than cut corners just because we have too many patients!
...*Sigh*. You pick the strangest things to be stubborn about.
I'm not asking you to give up your way of doing things.
...Huh?
This would just be temporary. Something to get us through the worst of it.
We start with a mild medicine to ease everyone's symptoms and keep the workload manageable...
And then later on, you can make proper, individualized medicine for them. Right?
Hmm...
I-Is that so...?
Th-That's right, Rana! We sometimes do that when treating patients, don't we?
We see how someone responds to a prescription, then adjust the ingredients and dosage for the next one.
Mmm...
<:player> and Sophia are right, Rana!
It's like eating your bell peppers before your treats! That's way better than saving the peppers for last!
...Not quite the same thing, but sure.
N-Nnngh... Well, if you all insist...
...A-Alright, then.
Then I shall make a test batch at once!
...Huh? Right now?
Wait right there!
...*Sigh*. She really is a handful.
Wow, <:player>! I can't believe you got Rana to change her mind!
Thank you so much, <:player>.
Thanks to you, we can sort this out without hurting Rana's feelings.
...You've been going along with her for days just to spare her feelings?
Hehe. We have to think about everyone here at Saverim.
Besides, didn't you respect Rana's wishes as well, <:player>?
Well, that's just because it was the simplest way...
Anyway, at least we'll be able to prepare some medicine now.
Just checking... Her medicine really does work, right?
Of course— Ah.
...Huh?
...Haha. Let's just wait and see!
Somehow, I'm already starting to feel uneasy...
It is finished!!!
My special elixir is complete!
With this, we can rid the city of its curse!
Oh, already? You're sure about this?
...K-Kukuku. O-Of course!
Though it has been a while since I made medicine this way...
Still, there shouldn't be any serious side effects or lasting harm! Ahem!
...Well, as long as it works as a stopgap measure, that's fine.
So, where is the medicine?
Kukuku. Right here.
Gaaah!! Wh-What is this?! Get it away from me right now!!!
...A-Alright. Hmph...
*Gasp, gasp*...! Wh-What just happened...?
Mmm? Are you okay, <:player>?
That was the medicine Rana made!
Wh-Wait... You two... aren't bothered by that at all...?
Ahahaha... W-Well, you see...
Ah! It's probably because you aren't used to Rana's medicine, <:player>!
What you just saw is what Rana normally makes!
Th-That stuff is supposed to be medicine...?
Hmph! How dare you call my special elixir "that stuff"?!
Ehehehe. It does look pretty weird, though, doesn't it?
It even ended up on that famous urban legend website! What was it called again...?
I think it was called <bouten>The Ruin-Bringing Poison</bouten> or something?
I told you it's not poison, you idiot!!
Waah! I told you I'm not an idiot!
J-Just make it look less horrifying before you bring it back...
...Huh? What do you mean, my minion?
I mean its appearance... Do something about how it looks!
Just look at it! It looks like poison!
Don't "huh" me! Go fix it!
...A-Alright... *Sniff*...

10108060.t: A few days after we made the medicine at Saverim...
Vermont Plaza
(...Whew. Somehow, I managed to wrap things up here.)
(...They should be doing fine, right?)
(Well, they haven't contacted me, so I guess everything's fine.)
Oh.
...Kukuku. My minion, have you been well?
Yeah, yeah. I was actually just about to reach out to you.
How are things on your end? Everything okay?
A-Ahem... Y-Yes. Everything's fine!
Rana, what do you mean, everything's fine?! Just tell him the truth—
B-Be quiet! I can tell him myself!
*Sigh*... What's wrong now? We already fixed the stuff that looked like poison.
...It wasn't actually poison, was it?
Hmph! Stop calling it poison!
There was nothing wrong with my medicine!!
...Th-There was just one tiny, insignificant complication.
...Right. What tiny, insignificant complication?
Ahem... Well, I'll explain when you get back.
It concerns the curse, so we must discuss it in the utmost secrecy. Kukuku...
Oh, come on. Just tell me what—
I'll be waiting! Bye!!
...*Sigh*.
(...Well, I'm sure it'll be fine.)
(Doesn't sound like it's actually a huge deal, anyway.)
In Front of Humanitas Station
Phew...
(...Everything looks normal, at least.)
(Guess I'll look around and talk to some people.)
Excuse me, I have a question—
Huh? Who're you supposed to be?
Well? You stopped me. Aren't you going to say something?
Well... I was wondering if anything unusual's been happening around Humanitas lately...
Unusual? Pfft. Nothing ever changes.
It's still a rotten dump run for the rich assholes.
Uh... R-Right...?
But, uh... I heard that lethargy thing or whatever was going around recently.
Ah, that. Yeah, I know all about it. I had it too.
That whole lethargy thing was just the big corporations teaming up to rip us off, wasn't it?
Oh... I-It was? News to me.
Right, how would normal people know? Those bastards control all the info.
Of course they don't know. Only a chosen few, like me, have had their eyes opened by the <bouten>Organization</bouten>.
Wow... L-Lucky you. Chosen by the Organization...
Hehehe. Well, I got lucky.
Anyway... seems like you're pretty interested in our Organization too, huh?
What do you say? Want to help us bring down the fat cats and turn this rotten world upside down?
A-Ah, no... Thanks for the offer, but I have other things to do...
...Tch, really? Shame. But hey, come back if you change your mind.
I reckon you'd actually be pretty good at this.
R-Right... Good luck to you guys too.
Heh, yeah. Stay alive, and I'll see you around.
Hah. I really need to quit this damn maid job. *Sigh*...
That woman from earlier came back today...
Ugh... That smelly woman? I can't stand her...
Yes, I'm here. But that offer you made... You meant it, right?
If I become a Bunny Girl, I get top-tier pay, comprehensive insurance, medical support, and—
Saverim
K-Kukuku... M-My minion. Welcome b—
What on earth did you do?!
What did you do to make all the maids act like that?!
W-Wait a minuuute! I'll explain everything!!
S-So stop shaking meeee!!
There. I've stopped. Now tell me the truth.
Uuugh... W-Wait... I'm still dizzy...
Ah, <:player>! Ehehe, it's been a while!!
Hehe, did you finish everything you had to do?
More or less. But I didn't expect another crisis to pop up as soon as I got back...
What on earth happened while I was away?
Ahaha, well, about that...

10108070.t: Saverim
Now, everyone, let's relax with a cup of tea.
Uuugh... All I can see is spinning pudding...
You vicious, brutal minion... You weren't like this a thousand years ago...
I have no memory of that.
Ehehe, but I'm so glad you came, <:player>!
Even going for walks has been a nightmare lately! But now you'll get everyone back to normal, right?!
I don't have superpowers. I can't just snap my fingers and fix everything...
Hehe, but at least you didn't say you wouldn't help.
...Anyway, let's get back to what you were saying.
So the medicine we made last time took care of the lethargy...
But it worked a little too well, right?
Yes. Rana's medicine is what's called an antagonist. Put simply, it blocks whatever's causing the lethargy.
At first, there were no unusual symptoms. The trouble started later.
Patients who'd barely had the energy to move... suddenly had far too much.
About that "energy"...
The maids I saw seemed a bit different.
They weren't exactly energetic... More like <bouten>cynical</bouten>, I guess?
